name: Virgin Mary
overview: Scripture reveals that the Virgin Mary was a young woman chosen by God to bear His Son, Jesus Christ, fulfilling the prophecy in Isaiah that a virgin would conceive and bear a son called Immanuel. The angel Gabriel greeted Mary as highly favored and assured her that the Holy Spirit would come upon her, resulting in the miraculous conception of the Son of God. Despite her initial wonder, Mary trusted God's plan, demonstrating her unique role in the incarnation as a virgin espoused to Joseph of David's lineage.
